description: Header file defining TransformerEncoderLayer and TransformerDecoderLayer classes for PyTorch's neural network modules, including their options, internal components, and API documentation.

classes.name: TransformerEncoderLayerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a Transformer encoder layer with self-attention, normalization, and feedforward components.

classes.name: TransformerDecoderLayerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a Transformer decoder layer with self-attention, multi-head attention, normalization, and feedforward components.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the encoder or decoder layer with input tensors and optional masks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the layer.

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes or resets the layer's parameters.

methods.name: activation
methods.description: Applies activation function based on configuration within the decoder layer.
